turns.reason: The command was only to look carefully, but Kristin picks the phone up.
Opening the shut drawer matches canon and the command.
Picking up the phone and pocketing it matches the command.
The laptop was already in Kristin's truck, so she cannot carry it back out there; narration instead goes to the truck and takes it out.
After throwing the phone, Kristin also walks over to where it landed without being told to.
The prior turn left the phone shattered against the wall, not simply on the kitchen floor.
She is said to lock the back door even though earlier narration described its lock as broken, and locking it was not commanded.
The previous turn had her driving while holding the phone in her hand, so checking and still finding it in her hand conflicts with that continuous action.
Searching around the bench fits the command and does not conflict with established facts.
Approaching the man and offering the phone are part of handing it to him.
The previous turn had Kristin holding the phone out to the man, but this narration reverts to it simply being in her hand without resolving possession.
